2) "找出邁阿密最受歡迎的旅遊景點。" - find the most popular sightseeing spot in Miami (most likely with default kids-friendly? They didn't specify but we can use default).

We have two tool calls available: supermarket_find_in_city and sightseeing_popular_in_city.

We'll call supermarket_find_in-city with city="Los Angeles", state maybe "California". And openNow default True; they want all supermarkets so probably include closed ones too? To get all supermarkets regardless of opening status, we should pass openNow:false.

Second call: sightseeing_popular_in_city with city="Miami", state="Florida". KidsFriendly default true. That will return the most popular kid-friendly sightseeings. Good.
